classes.name: AICharacterPedestrian
classes.comment: Pooled pedestrian (fpPeds 0x1dde98, 16 slots); size 0x290 from deleting destructor 24700 FastFree (PS2 probably 0x2a0). Own fields uniformly PS2 -0x10 (PS2 +0x150..+0x290 -> Xbox +0x140..+0x280); the chars at +0x150/+0x151 and bools at +0x1b4/+0x250 cause no further shift.

fields.name: pedIndex

fields.name: worldPos

fields.name: collider

fields.name: prevState

fields.name: pedFlags

classes.name: AICharacterEnemySnow
classes.comment: Snowmobile-riding enemy (ctor(MATRIX4 &, int weapon, PVehicle *), sets injuryZones 0x1b51d8); size 0x170 from dtor 1fdd0. Own fields uniformly PS2 -0x10.

fields.name: vehicle
fields.evidence: ctor 1fd40 stores arg3 (ctor(MATRIX4 &, int, PVehicle *)); DoNeutral makes vtable calls on it; PhysicsObject::GetHitPoints hint; PS2 +0x150 (GetVehiclePtr)

fields.name: leanDirection
fields.evidence: ctor 0; DoNeutral writes 0 or 1 together with subState 0x15; DoLeaning reads; PS2 +0x154. Name invented

fields.name: aimPitchDir
fields.evidence: ctor 0; DoAiming XORs it with base +0x94 to choose the +/- step for aimPitch; PS2 +0x158. Name invented

fields.name: aimTimer
fields.evidence: ctor 0; DoAiming increments it, compares with +0x150, resets; PS2 +0x15c. Name invented

fields.name: aimTimerLimit
fields.evidence: ctor 0; DoAiming sets (random*0xb4)>>16 (0..180); PS2 +0x160. Name invented

fields.name: targetAngle
fields.evidence: ctor 0; TargetIsInRange 20710 stores an angle (FST); DoAiming scales it; PS2 +0x164 float. Name invented

fields.name: aimYaw
fields.evidence: ctor 0; DoAiming steps toward targetAngle, clamps to +/-90 (0x42b40000), passes to 0x114c60 (rotation builder); PS2 +0x168. Name invented

fields.name: aimPitch

fields.name: blendWeights

fields.name: blendRates
fields.evidence: added to blendWeights each frame, zeroed when clamped; DoAiming/DoArmed/DoNeutral/PlayZoneInjuryAnim write; PS2 +0x178 LEA/W, +0x17c. Name invented

classes.name: AICharacterEnemySunroof
classes.comment: Enemy in a car sunroof (ctor(MATRIX4 &, int weapon, int, PVehicle *), owns a WTargetable); size 0x170 from dtor 21230. Own fields uniformly PS2 -0x10; +0x144..+0x14f unaccessed on both builds.

fields.name: vehicle
fields.evidence: ctor 210f0 stores arg4 and reads its word +0x4a (rigid body index) for Simulation::GetRigidBody; PhysicsObject::GetHitPoints hint; PS2 +0x150 (GetVehiclePtr)

fields.name: lastVehicleVelocity
fields.evidence: ctor copies GetRigidBody(vehicle)->velocity (+0x20) here; PS2 +0x160 (w8 + w4) written by ctor and DoTilting (VehicleIsAccelerating compares). Name invented

fields.name: unknown15c
fields.evidence: ctor 0; DoArmed/DoLeaning R/W; PS2 +0x16c also in VehicleIsAccelerating

fields.name: partnerA
fields.evidence: ctor 0; TargetIsInRange 218f0 dereferences [+0x160]+0xa8 (actor iterator) ->+8 ->byte +0x24, as for an AICharacter; DoInitial writes; PS2 +0x170. Name invented

fields.name: partnerB
fields.evidence: same pattern as +0x160; PS2 +0x174. Name invented

fields.name: targetable
fields.evidence: ctor FastAlloc(0x50) then WTargetable ctor 0xcd9b0(this) and stores it; ~AICharacterEnemySunroof/DoDying call WTargetable::RemoveReference; PS2 +0x178 (its ~AICharacter hint is a folded dtor)

notes: All three subclasses start their own fields at Xbox +0x140 = PS2 +0x150 (PS2 AICharacter keeps its vptr last at +0x140), and the -0x10 shift holds to the end of every class.

The evidence scanner missed some Xbox accesses: DoStartled 27150 takes LEA [ESI+0x170] (passed to SetTarget 23ba0) though +0x170 is absent from the table. Pedestrian +0x151, +0x158 and +0x200 are placed from PS2 alone.
Pedestrian +0x210/+0x220/+0x230 are 16 bytes apart on both builds with the 4th dword unaccessed: they may be COORD4s or padded vectors; typed COORD3.

Pedestrian DoAiming fields +0x26c..+0x280 look like EnemySnow's aim block (+0x148..+0x16c): targetAngle +0x274 matches Snow +0x154 (both written by TargetIsInRange). Pedestrian +0x284..+0x28f unaccessed.

Return types: TargetIsInRange (Ped 24b30, Snow 20710, Sunroof 218f0) return AL 0/1; UpdateClosestPed 23ce0 returns the ped index in EAX (-1 if none); ReachedTarget 24e50 is tested with TEST AL by DoWalking; ThreatenedByVehicle 26760 is tested with TEST EAX by DoStartled (int).
Sunroof ctor takes 4 args (RET 0x10): MATRIX4 &, int weapon (clamped 1..2 into base +0x68), an int stored in base +0x70, PVehicle *. The PS2 sheet truncates the signature.
Snow +0x140 and Sunroof +0x140 carry a PhysicsObject::GetHitPoints hint; typed PVehicle * since PS2 GetVehiclePtr returns them and the Snow ctor takes PVehicle *.
Snow DoNeutral 1fe00 calls 0x1fc80 (not in the method list) with the vehicle pointer loaded: an unnamed helper in the AICharacterEnemySnow address range.
AnimationController (Ped +0x1c4) typed void *, as in cluster7.
